opening_thought: Salt air. Open deck. The ship is empty — a blank page over deep water.

thoughts.ship_arrival: No puzzles yet. Just wood, sail, and horizon. Room enough to build something true.

ship_arrival.title: On the Deck
ship_arrival.body: You fell through and landed on an empty ship at sea. The level is waiting to be designed.
ship_arrival.thought: Blank water. Blank deck. Start fresh.

ending.title: Ship Level
ending.body: The deck fades back toward the bedroom.
